held.claim: A Supreme Court lawyer's legal-advice answer (Prothom Alo, 17 April 2024) to the child of a returnee who abuses the mother: under the Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Act 2010 the woman can apply for protection to the officer in charge of any police station, the women affairs officer or directly to the court, which sets a hearing date within seven days of the application.
